findings.title: No automated regression test verifies SQL expressions remain disabled
findings.body: This security-sensitive behavior is implemented without accompanying tests. Add coverage that submits a QueryTypeSQL expression with FlagSqlExpressions both enabled and disabled and asserts that it is rejected, plus coverage for the legacy SQL command construction path if it remains reachable. Without this, a future refactor of the feature-toggle logic or command wiring can silently re-enable SQL execution and reintroduce the RCE/LFI exposure.
